title: The empty line that ended a keep scalar goes with the old value when a mapping replaces it
notes: The empty line after `two` is a line break of the keep scalar (section 8.1.1.2), so it is part of the text of the value that is replaced, and it goes with that value; only the comment line after it stays. Left in place it would read back the same after the new mapping, so dropping it is a kit convention (see Kit conventions in docs/edit-semantics.md), unlike `edit/set-literal-keep-drops-the-extra-line`, where exact read-back requires it. The new block mapping is indented by the document's block indentation step, two spaces here, also a convention.

provenance.reference: Found by comparing random edits of random documents with a plain model while building a lossless document for a Python library.
